HLT-CT-9.why: single-instrument trim: CTR Art. 61 (manufacturing/import authorisation) was kept only as an 'adjacent fit' (author rationale); also removes the stale 'ICH E6(R2) §5.14' left in L5

singleInstrumentPolicy.rule: One binding anchor per question. Extra parts allowed only when they are: provisions of the same instrument; its codification, implementing regulation, amending or proposed amending act, or guidance issued under it by the same authority; a standard it incorporates by reference; a non-binding means document applied to meet it; or the counterpart provision of another jurisdiction imposing the same obligation. Two different obligations from different instruments fail and were trimmed.
